race.comment: SHOCAIR (5) is the horse with the most upside. She was beaten just over five lengths as favourite on debut at Newcastle in June but resumes with a solid second at Warwick Farm in the bank. Looks to have her share of ability and she can return with a bang. IN CIRCLES (1) is racing in good order without winning, going under by just over a length at Hawkesbury last time after a second at this venue. That form stacks up here and she can cross from out wide with her early speed. FRANKIE'S BOY (2) was just fair first-up off a very long break, though this presents as a more suitable assignment. RED PLANET BAR (4) gets the blinkers on for the first time today and with his upside, he can't be discounted.
